name: Wana Optimal | 100mg Fast Asleep | Dream Berry
description:
Dream Berry 

Per Package: 100mg CBD, 20mg CBN, 20mg CBG, 20mg THC 

Per Piece: 10mg CBD, 2mg CBN, 2mg CBG, 2mg THC 

Feel sleepy in just 5-15 minutes, with no next-day grogginess. These revolutionary nighttime gummies deliver a custom blend of CBD, THC, CBG, and CBN. They’re enhanced with more than 30 Indica-leaning terpenes – all delivered via fast-acting molecular encapsulation technology. They're also vegan, naturally melt-proof, and made with organic sweeteners.
